events.title: Proposed ruling: no_action (model confidence 0.86)
events.body:
The trip produced one off-route segment: 10:04–10:07, 1.94 km driven where the optimal route covers 0.22 km, adding 1.73 km [F3]. Under RD-1 that segment is a deviation and must be reviewed against RD-3 / RD-4 / RD-5 for exemption [F3][RD-1].

RD-4 does not exempt it: there is no traffic incident on the replaced stretch of the optimal route, and the speed-band records are only corroborative, not standalone grounds for exemption [F10][F11][F12][RD-4]. RD-3 also does not apply, because this was not a rider-named stop but a driver-proposed routing [F3][RD-3].

RD-5 does exempt it. The driver asked at 10:01, before leaving the optimal route, "ok if I go round via Halus Link?", naming the Halus Link corridor, and the rider replied "Sure, go ahead" at the same time, before the off-route segment began at 10:04 [F7][F8][F3]. The consent therefore covers the corridor the driver actually named, and nothing in the facts shows the vehicle went somewhere other than Halus Link [F7][F8][F9][RD-5]. The segment is exempt and the deviation is not chargeable.

RD-2 confirms the amount is nil. RydeX is a fixed-fare, non-metered service: the fare was quoted at booking and the billed distance (9.9 km) never exceeded the optimal route (9.9 km), so the 1.8 km of extra driving produced no extra charge [F1][F4][F6][RD-2]. Refundable amount is 0, so the correct outcome is no_action, and the RD-1 breach is not recorded because the segment is exempt [RD-2].

RD-6 is not triggered: the driver has no upheld route dispute in the last 90 days, so no account flag is warranted [F15][RD-6].

No voucher is being issued. No action is being taken against the driver.

What settled it: you asked the rider before leaving the normal route whether you could go via Halus Link, and the rider agreed at the time. The trip was also on a fixed fare, and the billed distance never went over the normal route, so the extra driving didn't change what the rider paid. No refund is due, no amount is being deducted from you, and no note is going on your account.
